# Fourth-Party and Dependency Chain Risk

## Purpose

Account for material risk from suppliers' own critical dependencies and subcontractors.

## Assessment

Depth should follow the importance of the supplier and whether downstream parties can access sensitive information, privileged systems, critical infrastructure, or essential service delivery.

## Signals

Consider concentration, geographic commonality, subcontractor incidents, change transparency, substitution difficulty, and contractual flow-down of important obligations.

## Limit

Complete visibility into every dependency is rarely practical. Focus on material chains and record uncertainty rather than assuming unknown dependencies are low risk.
